title: Microsoft Windows Server – Operating System Core
description: The Microsoft Windows Server operating system providing the base execution environment, local security boundary, kernel services, and platform security controls for hosted roles and applications.

implemented-requirements.description: The Windows Server operating system is configured in accordance with approved configuration baselines and security hardening guidance.
The operating system enforces local credential policies and integrates with domain-based authentication mechanisms.
The operating system provides integrity checking mechanisms and supports antimalware and host intrusion prevention tools.
The operating system supports timely patching and update mechanisms to remediate vendor-identified flaws.
